_source: v1.1 (Decision 35) seed: the 115 CDP 2023 controlled action labels (adaptbase-core cdp_solution_crosswalk.json; every label is a concept or an alias), the Solution names reused by two or more plans in the graph on 2026-10-01 (adaptbase-core#321 §2.6 d), and solution-categories subcategories that name a concrete intervention.
_usage: Solution.concept_id. Each concept carries the category_id, subcategory_id and ipcc_action_types that the seeder copies onto the Solution node; extraction never writes those three.
_note: Governed, growing list: closed to the extractor (a class not on the list is emitted with proposed: true and reviewed), open through the proposal queue. New concepts arrive as a PR to this file with added_in set; deprecation keeps the id with status: deprecated and replaced_by. cdp_labels records which CDP controlled labels fold into the concept, for the CDP import. aliases are identity-grade synonyms for the resolver.

concepts.name: Sea wall
concepts.definition: A hard engineered structure along a shoreline that resists wave action, surge and erosion.
cdp_labels: Sea walls and coastal protection structures

concepts.name: Levee
concepts.definition: An earthen or concrete barrier along a river or coast that keeps floodwater out of the protected area.
cdp_labels: Flood defence, such as flood levees and culverts

concepts.name: Storm surge barrier
concepts.definition: A movable or fixed barrier across an estuary or channel that closes against storm surge.

concepts.name: Culvert and bridge opening upgrade
concepts.definition: Enlarging or replacing culverts and bridge openings so that watercourses pass design floods.

concepts.name: Flood detention basin
concepts.definition: An engineered basin that temporarily stores floodwater and releases it slowly.

concepts.name: Stormwater drainage upgrade
concepts.definition: Expanding or rebuilding piped and channel drainage so it carries larger storm flows.

concepts.name: Combined sewer overflow control
concepts.definition: Measures that keep combined sewers from discharging untreated flow during storms.

concepts.name: Flood pump station
concepts.definition: A pumping installation that moves stormwater or floodwater out of low-lying areas.

concepts.name: Rainwater harvesting
concepts.definition: Collecting and storing rainfall from roofs or surfaces for later use.

concepts.name: Water recycling and reuse
concepts.definition: Treating wastewater or greywater for reuse in place of fresh supply.

concepts.name: Desalination
concepts.definition: Producing fresh water from seawater or brackish water.

concepts.name: Water supply diversification
concepts.definition: Adding supply sources or interconnections so that a city is not dependent on one source.

concepts.name: Managed aquifer recharge
concepts.definition: Deliberately replenishing aquifers with surface or recycled water.

concepts.name: Water efficiency retrofit
concepts.definition: Replacing fixtures, appliances and processes to cut water use.

concepts.name: Leak detection and loss reduction
concepts.definition: Finding and fixing losses in the distribution network.

concepts.name: Smart water metering
concepts.definition: Metering that reports consumption continuously to utility and customer.

concepts.name: Water use restrictions
concepts.definition: Rules that limit water use during drought or shortage.

concepts.name: Water pricing and tariffs
concepts.definition: Price structures that reward lower or off-peak water use.

concepts.name: Flood and water level monitoring
concepts.definition: Sensors and gauges that report water levels in rivers, sewers and the sea in real time.

concepts.name: Hydrological and flood modelling
concepts.definition: Models that estimate where and how deep water goes under storms, tides and sea-level rise.

concepts.name: Integrated water resource management
concepts.definition: Managing supply, stormwater, wastewater and ecosystems together in one planning frame.

concepts.name: Water and wastewater treatment upgrade
concepts.definition: Expanding, hardening or relocating treatment works.
cdp_labels: Ensure access to resilient secure, sustainable and safely managed sanitation services

concepts.name: Water quality monitoring
concepts.definition: Monitoring contaminants in supply, rivers or coastal water.

concepts.name: Green infrastructure
concepts.definition: Vegetated and soil-based systems that manage stormwater and provide ecosystem services, used as the umbrella class when the text names no specific measure.

concepts.name: Rain garden
concepts.definition: A planted depression that captures and infiltrates runoff from nearby surfaces.

concepts.name: Bioswale
concepts.definition: A vegetated channel that slows, filters and infiltrates runoff.

concepts.name: Constructed wetland
concepts.definition: An engineered wetland built to store and treat stormwater or wastewater.

concepts.name: Wetland and floodplain restoration
concepts.definition: Restoring wetlands, floodplains or buried watercourses to store and slow floodwater.
cdp_labels: Ecological restoration (including wetland and floodplain conservation and restoration)

concepts.name: Living shoreline
concepts.definition: A shoreline stabilised with vegetation, oyster reef or sand instead of hard structure.

concepts.name: Beach and dune nourishment
concepts.definition: Adding sand to beaches or dunes to maintain a buffer against erosion and surge.

concepts.name: Mangrove conservation and restoration
concepts.definition: Protecting or replanting mangrove forest as coastal defence and habitat.

concepts.name: Reef restoration
concepts.definition: Restoring or building reefs that attenuate waves.

concepts.name: Urban tree planting
concepts.definition: Planting and maintaining trees in streets, parks and private land for shade, cooling and stormwater benefit.

concepts.name: Urban greening
concepts.definition: Adding vegetated public space in the urban fabric, used when the text names no specific measure.

concepts.name: Green corridor
concepts.definition: A connected strip of vegetated land that links habitats or open spaces.

concepts.name: Protected natural area
concepts.definition: Land designated and managed for conservation.
cdp_labels: Preservation of local and regional agricultural space

concepts.name: Biodiversity and ecosystem monitoring
concepts.definition: Systematic observation of species and habitats.

concepts.name: Ecosystem-based adaptation
concepts.definition: Using ecosystems and their services to reduce climate risk, as an umbrella class when no specific measure is named.
cdp_labels: Ex situ conservation and seed banks

concepts.name: Prescribed burning and fuel reduction
concepts.definition: Deliberate burning or clearing of vegetation to reduce wildfire fuel.

concepts.name: Invasive species and vector control
concepts.definition: Managing invasive species, pests and disease vectors whose range shifts with climate.

concepts.name: Fisheries management
concepts.definition: Rules and institutions that keep fisheries within sustainable limits.

concepts.name: Slope and erosion control
concepts.definition: Vegetation or structures that hold soil on slopes and riverbanks.

concepts.name: Green roof
concepts.definition: A roof covered with growing medium and vegetation.

concepts.name: Cool roof
concepts.definition: A roof surface with high solar reflectance that lowers building and ambient temperature.

concepts.name: Building cooling retrofit
concepts.definition: Installing or upgrading mechanical cooling in existing buildings.

concepts.name: Passive cooling and ventilation
concepts.definition: Building design that keeps interiors cool without mechanical cooling.

concepts.name: Building insulation and envelope upgrade
concepts.definition: Improving the thermal envelope of buildings.

concepts.name: Building floodproofing
concepts.definition: Modifying a building so that flooding does less damage.
cdp_labels: Resilience and resistance measures for buildings

concepts.name: Resilient building code
concepts.definition: Code and standard provisions that require buildings to withstand climate hazards.

concepts.name: Resilient and modular housing
concepts.definition: Housing built or retrofitted to resist local hazards.

concepts.name: Shade structures
concepts.definition: Built shade and misting in public space.

concepts.name: Wildfire home hardening
concepts.definition: Building and landscape measures that reduce ignition of structures by wildfire.

concepts.name: Post-disaster repair and rebuilding
concepts.definition: Repairing and rebuilding damaged buildings to a higher standard.

concepts.name: Affordable and climate-safe housing
concepts.definition: Housing programmes that keep vulnerable residents in safe, affordable homes; recorded as a Solution only when framed as adaptation.

concepts.name: Permeable pavement
concepts.definition: Paving that lets water infiltrate rather than run off.

concepts.name: Critical infrastructure hardening
concepts.definition: Strengthening or protecting infrastructure assets against hazards, used when the asset class is not specific.
cdp_labels: Hazard resistant infrastructure design and construction

concepts.name: Infrastructure relocation
aliases: relocating infrastructure out of hazard zones
concepts.definition: Moving an asset out of a hazard zone.

concepts.name: Infrastructure condition monitoring
concepts.definition: Instrumenting assets to detect deterioration and hazard impact.

concepts.name: Digital twin and smart city platform
concepts.definition: A data platform that models the city for planning and operations.

concepts.name: Resilient waste management
concepts.definition: Waste systems that keep operating through hazards and reduce exposure.
cdp_labels: Ensure all waste generated is collected ensure residual waste disposed of adequately in an engineered sanitary landfill
Municipal services to reduce food waste (including composting)

concepts.name: Microgrid
concepts.definition: A local grid that can operate independently of the main grid.

concepts.name: Battery storage and backup power
concepts.definition: Stored or standby power that keeps services running in outages.

concepts.name: Solar photovoltaics
concepts.definition: Solar electricity generation, recorded as a Solution when framed as resilience.

concepts.name: Grid hardening
concepts.definition: Strengthening generation and distribution assets against hazards.
cdp_labels: Increase resilience of and/or diversify power/energy supply

concepts.name: Transmission line undergrounding
concepts.definition: Moving overhead lines underground.

concepts.name: Utility vegetation management
concepts.definition: Managing vegetation near power lines to prevent outages and ignition.

concepts.name: Renewable energy
concepts.definition: Renewable generation other than solar PV, recorded when framed as resilience.

concepts.name: Energy efficiency
concepts.definition: Reducing energy demand in buildings and systems.

concepts.name: Cool pavement
concepts.definition: Road surfaces that reflect more sunlight.

concepts.name: Road and bridge hardening
concepts.definition: Strengthening, raising or protecting roads, bridges and tunnels.

concepts.name: Resilient transit
concepts.definition: Protecting transit systems and keeping them running through hazards.

concepts.name: Fleet electrification
concepts.definition: Electrifying vehicles and fleets, recorded when framed as resilience.

concepts.name: Evacuation routes and logistics
concepts.definition: Designated routes and logistics for moving people and goods in an emergency.

concepts.name: Transit-oriented development
concepts.definition: Dense, mixed-use development around transit, recorded when framed as resilience.

concepts.name: Cooling centre
concepts.definition: A public facility opened during heat for people to cool down.

concepts.name: Resilience hub
concepts.definition: A trusted community facility equipped to support residents before, during and after a hazard event.

concepts.name: Emergency shelter
concepts.definition: A facility that houses people displaced by a hazard event.

concepts.name: Heat health programme
concepts.definition: Coordinated public-health response to extreme heat, including outreach and warnings.

concepts.name: Air quality programme
concepts.definition: Measures that reduce or monitor air pollution worsened by heat and wildfire.
cdp_labels: Measuring days with extreme air pollution due to climate events
Undertaken source-related studies to understand sources of air pollution

concepts.name: Disease surveillance and prevention
concepts.definition: Monitoring and preventing climate-sensitive disease.
cdp_labels: Public health policies to improve nutrition (including improved access to healthy foods)

concepts.name: Heat stress monitoring
concepts.definition: Measuring heat exposure of people and places.

concepts.name: Urban agriculture
concepts.definition: Growing food within the city.
cdp_labels: Financial support to expand local food production (including urban agriculture programs, community gardens, etc.)
Land zoning laws to increase local food access (including grocery stores, farmers markets, community gardens, etc.)

concepts.name: Climate-resilient cropping
concepts.definition: Changing crops, varieties or practices to suit a changed climate.
cdp_labels: Changing cropping practices, patterns, and planting dates (including crop-switching)

concepts.name: Efficient irrigation
concepts.definition: Irrigation that delivers water with less loss.

concepts.name: Food storage and cold chain
concepts.definition: Facilities that keep food safe and available through disruption.
cdp_labels: Cold food storage, preservation and/or distribution facilities

concepts.name: Food security programme
concepts.definition: Programmes and policies that keep food affordable and available, recorded when framed as adaptation.
cdp_labels: Food donation and redistribution of food surplus
Community engagement/awareness campaigns on the climate and health benefits of sustainable healthy diets
Engagement with retailers (including restaurants) to expand and encourage sustainable, healthy food choices
Financial support to improve market access for local food producers
Municipal/jurisdictional food procurement policies that align with guidelines for sustainable, healthy diets (including school procurement, etc.)
Municipal/jurisdictional food procurement policies that support sustainable food production practices (including school procurement, etc.)
Public policies to encourage citizen dietary shift to sustainable, healthy diets (including incentivizing purchase of low-carbon foods, plant-based or alternative proteins)

concepts.name: Drought monitoring
concepts.definition: Monitoring that detects drought onset and severity.

concepts.name: Climate risk insurance
concepts.definition: Insurance products that transfer climate risk, including requirements to carry them.

concepts.name: Resilience incentives and subsidies
concepts.definition: Payments, rebates or tax measures that reward adaptation by households and firms.

concepts.name: Resilience lending
concepts.definition: Loan programmes that fund adaptation by households, firms or communities.

concepts.name: Disaster contingency fund
concepts.definition: A reserve set aside to pay for response and recovery.

concepts.name: Social protection and cash transfers
concepts.definition: Transfers and safety nets that cushion households against climate shocks.
cdp_labels: Social safety nets and social protection

concepts.name: Economic and livelihood diversification
concepts.definition: Reducing dependence on climate-exposed livelihoods and sectors.

concepts.name: Climate risk and vulnerability assessment
concepts.definition: A structured assessment of hazards, exposure and vulnerability.

concepts.name: Managed retreat
concepts.definition: Moving people and assets out of hazard zones through buyouts or relocation.

concepts.name: Hazard-based zoning and land-use regulation
concepts.definition: Land-use rules that limit development in hazard-prone areas.
cdp_labels: Land zoning laws (including restrict development in at risk areas)

concepts.name: Adaptation and resilience planning
concepts.definition: A planning process or instrument for adaptation, recorded as a Solution only when a plan prescribes planning as a measure.
cdp_labels: Development of targeted plan/program to address hazard(s) selected

concepts.name: Disaster preparedness planning
concepts.definition: Institutional preparation for hazard events.
cdp_labels: Law to support disaster risk reduction

concepts.name: Urban heat mapping
concepts.definition: Mapping surface and air temperature across the city.

concepts.name: Hazard mapping
concepts.definition: Mapping hazard extent and probability other than flood and heat.

concepts.name: Climate and environmental monitoring
concepts.definition: Observation networks and remote sensing for climate and hazard conditions.

concepts.name: Climate projections and downscaling
concepts.definition: Producing local climate projections for planning.

concepts.name: Wildfire detection and suppression
concepts.definition: Systems that detect and suppress wildfire.

concepts.name: Early warning system
concepts.definition: A system that detects a hazard and warns people in time to act.

concepts.name: Community engagement and education
concepts.definition: Informing and involving residents in adaptation.

concepts.name: Community-based adaptation
concepts.definition: Adaptation designed and delivered by communities.

concepts.name: Preparedness training and drills
concepts.definition: Training residents and responders for hazard events.

concepts.name: Telecommunications hardening
concepts.definition: Keeping communications working through hazard events.

concepts.name: Emergency response capacity
concepts.definition: Equipment, staffing and facilities for emergency response.

concepts.name: Adaptation governance body
concepts.definition: A standing body or role that coordinates adaptation across government.

concepts.name: Climate mainstreaming in policy
concepts.definition: Requiring climate risk to be considered in routine decisions.

concepts.name: Informal settlement upgrading
concepts.definition: Improving services, housing and drainage in informal settlements.
